// p3net is F4's witness (Burroughs #1239): Go's net package on the fork's GOOS=wasip3, over
// wasi:sockets' tcp-socket. It listens, dials itself, echoes 1 MiB, times a read out, dials a closed
// port, closes a listener under a parked Accept, and serves and gets one HTTP request, all inside one
// instance with no peer outside it. It prints properties, never a port, an address or error text.
//
// With no network grant, the listen is refused at tcp-socket.create (access-denied), and p3net prints
// that and what a dial gets, and stops.
package main

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"syscall"
	"time"
)

const echoBytes = 1 << 20

func main() {
	ln, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("listen refused, EACCES:", errors.Is(err, syscall.EACCES))
		_, err = net.Dial("tcp", "127.0.0.1:9")
		fmt.Println("dial refused, EACCES:", errors.Is(err, syscall.EACCES))
		return
	}
	la, ok := ln.Addr().(*net.TCPAddr)
	fmt.Println("listening on 127.0.0.1 with a port:", ok && la.IP.Equal(net.IPv4(127, 0, 0, 1)) && la.Port != 0)

	// 1 MiB through an io.Copy echo, written and read concurrently, then CloseWrite and read to EOF.
	served := make(chan net.Conn, 1)
	go func() {
		c, err := ln.Accept()
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Println("accept:", err)
			os.Exit(1)
		}
		served <- c
		io.Copy(c, c)
		c.Close()
	}()
	c, err := net.Dial("tcp", ln.Addr().String())
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("dial:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	sc := <-served
	payload := make([]byte, echoBytes)
	for i := range payload {
		payload[i] = byte(i*7 + i>>8)
	}
	wrote := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		_, err := c.Write(payload)
		if err == nil {
			err = c.(*net.TCPConn).CloseWrite()
		}
		wrote <- err
	}()
	h := sha256.New()
	n, err := io.Copy(h, c)
	werr := <-wrote
	fmt.Println("echoed 1 MiB, sha256 matches:", err == nil && werr == nil && n == echoBytes &&
		string(h.Sum(nil)) == string(sha(payload)))
	fmt.Println("addresses cross-match:", c.LocalAddr().String() == sc.RemoteAddr().String() &&
		c.RemoteAddr().String() == sc.LocalAddr().String() && sc.LocalAddr().String() == ln.Addr().String())
	c.Close()

	// A read with a 5 ms deadline times out; the bytes written after it are then read.
	late := make(chan struct{})
	go func() {
		c, err := ln.Accept()
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Println("accept:", err)
			os.Exit(1)
		}
		<-late
		c.Write([]byte("late"))
		c.Close()
	}()
	c, err = net.Dial("tcp", ln.Addr().String())
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("dial:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	c.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(5 * time.Millisecond))
	buf := make([]byte, 16)
	_, err = c.Read(buf)
	fmt.Println("read deadline, os.ErrDeadlineExceeded:", errors.Is(err, os.ErrDeadlineExceeded))
	close(late)
	c.SetReadDeadline(time.Time{})
	got, err := io.ReadAll(c)
	fmt.Println("late bytes read after the deadline:", err == nil && string(got) == "late")
	c.Close()

	// A dial to a port nobody listens on is refused.
	gone, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("listen:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	closed := gone.Addr().String()
	gone.Close()
	_, err = net.Dial("tcp", closed)
	fmt.Println("dial to a closed port, ECONNREFUSED:", errors.Is(err, syscall.ECONNREFUSED))

	// Close of a listener with an Accept parked on it ends that Accept with net.ErrClosed.
	parked, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("listen:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	accepted := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		_, err := parked.Accept()
		accepted <- err
	}()
	time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond)
	parked.Close()
	fmt.Println("parked Accept after Close, net.ErrClosed:", errors.Is(<-accepted, net.ErrClosed))

	// One HTTP request, served in-process on the first listener.
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	mux.HandleFunc("/hello", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		io.WriteString(w, "hello, wasip3\n")
	})
	go http.Serve(ln, mux)
	resp, err := http.Get("http://" + ln.Addr().String() + "/hello")
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("http get:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	resp.Body.Close()
	fmt.Printf("http: %s, body %q, length %d, read ok: %v\n", resp.Status, body, resp.ContentLength, err == nil)
}

func sha(b []byte) []byte {
	s := sha256.Sum256(b)
	return s[:]
}
